title: Handover — analyze → taskmaster
description: Canonical handover: after analysis, hand to taskmaster with explicit human go-ahead (gated).

title: Handover — taskmaster → implement
description: Canonical handover: once the spec is ready, hand to the implementer (gated).

title: Handover — taskmaster-change → implement
description: Canonical handover: once the revised spec is ready, hand to the implementer (gated).

title: Handover — implement → git (implemented)
description: Canonical handover: once implemented, hand to task-git to push (auto).

title: Handover — implement → git (changes-implemented)
description: Canonical handover: once requested changes are implemented, hand to task-git to push (auto).

title: Handover — git → review
description: Canonical handover: once pushed, hand to the reviewer (gated).

title: Handover — review → human review
description: Canonical handover: on approval, hand to the human reviewer (gated).

title: Handover — review → review-fix
description: Canonical handover: when a fix is needed, hand to the review fixer (gated).

title: Handover — review-fix → review
description: Canonical handover: once fixed, hand back to the reviewer (gated).

title: Handover — human review → review-fix
description: Canonical handover: when the human flags a fix, hand to the review fixer (gated).

title: Handover — human review → git
description: Canonical handover: on human approval, hand to task-git to merge/push (auto).

title: Handover — human review → request-changes
description: Canonical handover: when post-merge changes are needed, hand to request-changes (gated).

title: Handover — request-changes → implement
description: Canonical handover: once changes are requested, hand to the implementer (gated).
